exclusion_dispositions.object-key: Protected JSON member identity/group key, including IDs and API names. Key presence is not an English caption. Exact spelling may affect lookup/request behavior.
exclusion_dispositions.number: Protected numeric catalog configuration: costs, token/image/request limits, tiers or manifest version. Raw numeric spelling retained; no pricing/limit correctness claim.
exclusion_dispositions.boolean: Protected capability/configuration boolean, not authored prose; downstream adapters determine behavior.
exclusion_dispositions.null: Protected explicit JSON null, distinct from omitted/false/zero values.
exclusion_dispositions.manifest-string: Protected generation timestamp, structure hash, filename or file digest. Date.parse consumes generatedAt; structureHash generator algorithm is not independently closed.
exclusion_dispositions.identity: Protected model/provider/API/credential/source/type identity. Some IDs paint native/Jouzu rows or serialize through APIs; that does not make them translation labels.
exclusion_dispositions.endpoint: Protected endpoint/base URL. Runtime config, remote catalog, headers/auth and URL/HTTP clients may replace or consume it; no network operation performed.
exclusion_dispositions.configuration-string: Protected header/version, input/output modality, thinking/compat format, level mapping, variable or request configuration value. Downstream provider/client graph remains bounded; no absence-of-payload-display claim.

source_offsets: Half-open Unicode codepoint char, UTF16 code unit and UTF8 byte offsets; line/column are1-based, column in UTF16. source_text_json decodes to exact raw JSON token, decoded_value_json to its value; object-key pointer denotes member and role separates key/value.
complete_partition: Every JSON string key/value and number/boolean/null occurs once in positives or exclusions. Every object/array has exact pointer/type/member count/container spans in evidence. JSON punctuation/whitespace is parser structure, not prose. Independent standard-library JSON decode agrees; duplicate keys rejected.
closure_limit: Full finite JSON data/token/typed-container partition only; no execution, translation requirement, automatic model-name publication, whole provider graph closure or target-installed parity.
